name: Underground Apes
summary:
Following the events of Underground Apes the Apex Containment Network has collapsed. You are one of the last survivors trapped underground, hunted by creatures that should’ve never existed—genetically-modified apes gone rogue. The lights flicker, alarms echo, and the air is thick with dread. But this time, it’s not just about escape... it’s about uncovering what they buried beneath.

VR-Ready Immersion: Built for VR horror with interaction and networked grab physics.
